# Why GPUs Matter

::: {.subtitle}
A short explainer on the chip behind modern AI.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="statement" duration="5s" animation="kinetic" transition="fade" transitionDuration="500ms"}
Modern AI is computationally expensive.
:::

::: {.scene component="section-divider" duration="3s" animation="slide-up" transition="wipe" transitionDuration="500ms"}
::: {.kicker}
Part 1
:::

# Two kinds of chip
:::

::: {.scene component="comparison" duration="8s" animation="fade-in" transition="zoom" transitionDuration="600ms"}
::: {.left}
## CPU

Few powerful cores, built for general-purpose work.
:::

::: {.right}
## GPU

Thousands of simpler cores, built for parallel work.
:::
:::

::: {.scene component="bullets" duration="7s" animation="stagger" transition="slide" transitionDuration="500ms"}
::: {.heading}
## Where GPUs excel
:::

- Matrix maths for neural networks
- Image and video processing
- Physics and simulation
- Many small jobs at once
:::

::: {.scene component="section-divider" duration="3s" animation="fade-in" transition="fade" transitionDuration="500ms"}
